in_hebrew.name: Hauser
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hauser הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word "haus", meaning house. The surname Hauser is a topographic name for someone who lived in a house or was the owner of a house.
